title: Sum of Two Numbers
desc: Write a program in C that reads two space-separated integers from standard input and prints their sum.

title: Even or Odd Checker
desc: Write a program that takes an integer as input. Print 'Even' if the number is even, and 'Odd' if it is odd.

title: Factorial of a Number
desc: Given a non-negative integer n, write a program to calculate its factorial.

title: Valid Palindrome String
desc: Given a string of lowercase English letters, check if it reads the same forwards and backwards. Print 'Yes' or 'No'.

title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
desc:
Given two sorted arrays of integers, merge them into a single sorted array.

Input format:
First line: two integers N and M (sizes of the two arrays).
Second line: N space-separated integers (Array A).
Third line: M space-separated integers (Array B).

Output format:
Print the merged array space-separated.
constraints: A and B are sorted in ascending order.

title: Binary Search
desc:
Given a sorted array of integers of size N, and a target value, print the index (0-based) if the target is found. If not, print -1.

Input format:
First line: N (size of array).
Second line: N space-separated integers.
Third line: target value.
constraints: nums is sorted in ascending order
